<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v3/performance/subscription"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Searches only the subscription identified by the current subscription header. Results are newest first.
An empty metrics collection returns 200, not 404. The effective date window defaults to the last 24 hours.
Use skip, size, and hasNextPage to iterate through results.
